name: overlay
description: Centers itself over the nearest positioned ancestor, or over the viewport, without pushing anything else around.

attributes.name: data-fixed
attributes.description: Center over the viewport instead of the nearest positioned ancestor, and stay put while the page scrolls.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: The least space kept between the overlay and the edges of the box it covers.

a11y.notes: Positioning only. An overlay that interrupts the page needs focus management and a way to dismiss it, which the dialog and tooltip components provide; use those rather than this primitive alone for anything modal.
